scope: All public EuroPriv detection configs plus ten pinned OpenPII slices; unavailable specs reported. Existing test sets, not a new independent gateway challenge.
seed_policy: Score every available seed; single-seed rows; no pooling or best-seed selection.

inference.aggregation: transformers simple; remove remaining E/S label prefixes before KP mapping

operator: Replace union of exact native character spans with literal block placeholders. All non-O labels, no confidence threshold, no evaluation-label filtering, no whitespace-token expansion. Retain native spans and actual output. Local operator, not deployed gateway.
utility: Removed gold non-PII non-whitespace characters / all gold non-PII non-whitespace characters; empty denominator unavailable.
historical_comparisons: Main leaderboard aggregate scores remain historical. Paired inference requires identical ordered gold and actual operator receipts; missing evidence is unverified. RES-125 local receipts, if used, are explicitly separate reruns and keep their own runtime, truncation and operator provenance.
acceptance: gateway-contract v1: >=3 independent candidate seeds, each passes disjoint v2 Wilson CIs and negative paired cluster delta upper bound; utility delta upper <=0; preserve RO/PL legacy zero floors; all required language/review/disjointness gates. One seed cannot establish a win. Zero/zero is a scoped tie, not equivalence.
runtime_amendment: Initial 5.9.0 run retained only as diagnostics; final rows require full inference rerun on exact moe-extra pins.
